verdict.rationale: The only documented filing rail is a credentialed human Online Account (Sign In / Create an Account). The pack shows no system accounts, transmitter program, or batch-filing provider enrollment for software to transact with the Secretary of State. 'Data and Image Subscriptions' is a related bulk-data offering, not a transactional system-to-system channel. The 'software providers' resources belong to the Department of Revenue, a different agency, so they do not transfer to this product.
